brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Hex Cluster configurator only checks geometric fit (check_build meshClash = clear) and does not verify structural strength or load ratings. Build has 4x full bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,0,1;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:1,0,1;full) with top covers (cover:0,0,1;full;top, cover:1,0,1;full;top) forming shelf surfaces, but no 50 kg rating can be claimed per system rules.

Two notch drawer frames placed and clear: notch:0#0,1#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm-x2, double-height) at 0,1,0 k=1 and notch:0#1,-1#notch4 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf-x2, double-height) at 1,-1,0 k=4. Both are double-height and span two storeys of the 2-column structure.

finish.summary: Built 2x2-column shelf base (4 full bases, 2 high) with two double-height notch drawer frames and top covers as shelves. check_build ok=true, meshClash=clear (only INFO OPEN_CAP_FACE). Cannot verify 50 kg load rating — Hex Cluster does not model strength — so that requirement is unmet; two drawers requirement is met.

M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.

parts.name: Side connector, single
parts.use: Bridges the seam between two neighbouring cells and resists shear across it, for a cluster that gets pushed sideways rather than only loaded down.

parts.name: Side connector, double
parts.use: Bridges the seam between two neighbouring cells and resists shear across it, for a cluster that gets pushed sideways rather than only loaded down.
